title: Understanding the Plot
text: The plot shows a decreasing trend as the value of $$d$$ increases. This suggests that the y-axis could represent a quantity that decreases with more data or features.

title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
text: Consider what metrics in machine learning might decrease as the number of features or data points increases. Think about variance, bias, error, etc.

title: Variance Explanation
text: Variance in a model typically decreases as the amount of data increases. Could the y-axis represent variance?
